item.subject: maths
item.stem:
Rina studies the three pictures in the figure. Each picture is a square grid of dots: a 1-by-1 square, then a 2-by-2 square, then a 3-by-3 square.

Which claim correctly describes how to draw the next picture?

options.A: Any larger cluster of dots works, without keeping the square-grid construction from picture to picture.
options.B: Drawing the next square grid is what creates the square numbers in the first place.
options.C: The next picture is a 4-by-4 square of 16 dots, because each picture is an n-by-n square for n = 1, 2, 3, …
options.D: The next picture needs the full chapter shape-sequence table before it can be drawn.
